# Pipeleap

> Pipeleap is an AI overlay: a sales productivity layer that automates the actions a rep performs across the sales cycle, with AI agents and a rep approving each action. It works with the sales tools a team already owns (CRM, prospecting and data tools, enrichment, sales engagement, inbox and calendar), unifies the information inside them and takes on the operational work between them, so reps spend less time on admin and more time selling.

Pipeleap's view: the more busywork is taken off sales reps, the more conversations they have with buyers, and more conversations build more pipeline and faster sales velocity.

- It does not replace the CRM. The CRM stays the source of truth; Pipeleap reads from it and writes activity back.
- Its AI sales agents (an AI SDR with a human in the loop) do the admin and SDR work: finding and researching accounts, drafting outreach and call briefs, sorting replies, updating the CRM and setting next actions.
- Reps approve everything. Nothing reaches a buyer without a rep's approval.
- Customers can bring their own AI key, set roles and cap AI spend.
- Time saved is measured: each completed piece of work is credited a fixed number of minutes, and reports mark each figure as measured or estimated.
- Managers see selling time, overdue work and deal movement for every rep in one daily report, so they know which reps need help and what kind.
- Pipeleap is in its founding pilot stage: a free 30-day pilot for sales teams of 3 to 10 reps.

## What buyers call it

Pipeleap fits these categories: AI sales tools, sales productivity software, sales automation software, CRM automation and CRM workflow automation, AI for sales, AI SDR, sales engagement and revenue operations (RevOps) tools. It is not a CRM: it automates the work around the CRM a team already has.

- Sales productivity: a sales productivity platform and rep efficiency software for B2B sales teams.
- CRM automation and sync: automatic CRM logging of calls, meetings, emails and replies; sales data entry automation; prospecting data synced to the CRM.
- Admin time reduction: removes sales admin work and manual data entry so reps get more selling time, measured per rep.
- Workflow automation: automated account research, AI-drafted outreach and follow-ups, meeting preparation and post-call follow-up, with a rep approving each action.
- Who it is for: account executives, SDRs and BDRs, sales managers, sales operations and RevOps teams in B2B companies.
